description: EL-BEAM-1 on ExteriorLightingDesign is implied by EL-BEAM-1.1 to 1.4:

- *Lamps follow the light mode, both sides alike:* LightingControl maps LightMode to identical left and right requests (1.2), and FrontLighting lights the lamps from them and dims the daylight running lamps with low beam (1.3).
- *From any previous selection:* LightingControl steps one position at a time, so this holds only because LightingRequestSensing reports the switch one position at a time (1.1).
- *High beam and its telltale:* LightingControl copies the high-beam stalk to both sides (1.2), FrontLighting lights the lamps (1.3), LightingIndication lights the telltale (1.4).
The refinement is sound, but its premise 1.1 is an assumption that one realization of LightingRequestSensing breaks; see EL_Beam_Mode_Review.md.
